decisionGates.scope: current Codex login copied into a managed runner-only named volume; one current GitHub OAuth token runner-only; initially planned unauthenticated control monitoring; no second credential wait
decisionGates.supersededPremise: The repository was discovered to be private and unauthenticated control polling failed honestly with GitHub 404.

decisionGates.scope: runner-mediated private-repository monitor broker bounded strictly to mrbaron3/workflow and typed Issue/PR read operations; no generic proxy or credential sharing

resolvedDecisions.resolution: Keep the existing six independent LLM perspectives and deterministic functionality gate; do not change the seven-gate model.

resolvedDecisions.ambiguity: repository, base, required checks, and merge method
resolvedDecisions.resolution: The only Registration and mutable GitHub target is mrbaron3/workflow on main; required checks are macos and postgres; merge method is squash; synthetic unregistered input is rejected before any provider call.
Build control, runner, and PostgreSQL as separate standard-OCI targets from digest-pinned upstream bases; package and provider CLI versions are explicit; record exact resulting descriptors.

Use role-separated PostgreSQL credentials, credential-free control, runner-only GitHub OAuth, and either a provider API key or a private Codex auth.json copied by stdin into a managed volume. Because mrbaron3/workflow is private, control submits only durable typed Issue/PR reads and runner returns bounded identities through the allowlisted broker. PostgreSQL administrator rotation is transactional while DRAINING with zero work and verifies new-pass/old-fail; runner/application credentials are reseeded only after OFF. Every rotation then follows the same volume-preserving MONITOR_ONLY restart and fail-closed topology verification.

Use aquasec/trivy 0.65.0 at sha256:a22415a38938a56c379387a8163fcb0ce38b10ace73e593475d3658d578b2436; fail on HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerabilities and any secret finding; record scanner database and report digests.
Restart into MONITOR_ONLY first, verify Registration, cursor, job, attempt, lease, audit, and artifact references from volumes, and require an explicit transition before returning to ACTIVE.

Regression lineage is PR #9 and released Issues #11 through #16; completion requires the #17 PR merged at expected head, Issue #17 CLOSED/COMPLETED, merge reachable from origin/main, and PostgreSQL/GitHub current-state reconciliation. Parent #10 remains coordinator-owned and is never mutated here.

bootstrapCutover.reason: The integration implementation cannot be the normal main-branch runtime that merges the commit which first introduces that runtime.
bootstrapCutover.boundedAction: Claim and planning use the existing intake. A host checkout creates the implementation commit and draft PR only. After the current integration head exists, the real three-container runner performs current-head review reconciliation, required-check gating, expected-SHA merge, Issue release, and current GitHub reconciliation.
normalExecutionClaimsExcluded: host-side PR creation is not claimed as integrated execution
the needs-human-review planning record is not rewritten
no database job or GitHub state is manually rewritten to success
